notes: Model pilot (haiku arm; the same pole is tested independently by the other arm, pairing disclosed): this pole feeds the held pole bonsai1/L5/N7938- (zeroing this neuron removes 0.80 of the anchor's peak), from a batched edge measurement with 8 same-layer placebos. Label and all 16 sentences written by the Haiku 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Probe fire sentences scored 0.42 to 0.66 (passphrase highest) and every same-frame near miss stayed under 0.01 (password, sentence, and idea controls included), so the token holds. Band samples included phrasal and Russian pieces that I did not test, so the label is limited to the word phrase and its passphrase compound.
